settings.title: The perfect cart starts with constraints.
settings.text: The builder works best when the golfer chooses a base color, one accent, and a setup style before adding products.

settings.title: Assign products by role.
settings.text: In the theme editor, each slot can be tuned by bag color, accent, and setup style so the cart feels curated.

settings.title: Let golfers remove extras.
settings.text: The included toggles keep the build flexible: shoppers can keep the kit tight or add the fuller setup.

settings.title: Pick the profile
settings.text: Clean, Starter, Tour, or Gift sets the use case before any product is added.

settings.title: Read the build code
settings.text: The build code turns bag, accent, and kit type into a simple internal shorthand.

settings.title: Build the cart
settings.text: The add button sends the selected available product slots into the Shopify cart.

settings.question: Do products need to be assigned first?
settings.answer: Yes. The configurator can show placeholder slots, but the cart button needs real products assigned in the theme editor.

settings.question: Can one product appear in multiple builds?
settings.answer: Yes. Set the product slot to all bag colors, all accents, or all styles when it should be recommended broadly.

settings.question: Should every build have the same number of products?
settings.answer: No. Clean should stay tight, Starter should cover core essentials, Tour can be fuller, and Gift should stay easy to understand.

settings.heading: How the builder thinks.
settings.subheading: A plain-English guide for setting up the Build Your Bag configurator so it creates useful, matched carts instead of random bundles.
